scope: Actual Swift credit-cleanup helper and launch-policy tests against disposable synthetic CBlockFile containers. Checks one-byte preservation, exact backups, permissions, idempotence and rejection before writes. NativeGame source is bound for integration review; the engine and GUI are not executed by this fixture. Separate original-program and packaged-startup evidence establishes the game-specific credit meaning and attract behavior.
